subject.title: Feature: TTS delivery mode option — separate text + voice messages on Telegram

question: Should OpenClaw add a public TTS delivery policy that lets Telegram users choose separate text-plus-voice delivery, and should that policy live under global `messages.tts` or Telegram/channel-specific config?
rationale: The request is valid, but it adds public config and overlaps with captioned-final and voice-only TTS policies, so automation should not choose the product contract.

options.title: Approve a narrow delivery policy
options.body: Define a backward-compatible delivery mode with docs and tests for bundled, captioned, and separate behavior before implementation.

options.title: Keep captioned delivery as the direction
options.body: Reject the separate-delivery selector and document tagged/manual workarounds plus caption overflow behavior instead.

options.title: Defer until captioned-final resolves
options.body: Keep this issue open but wait for the related captioned-final PR direction before deciding the config shape.

recommendation.title: Approve a narrow delivery policy
recommendation.body: Define a backward-compatible delivery mode with docs and tests for bundled, captioned, and separate behavior before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The current TTS core/config and Telegram delivery history most consistently route through this owner signal.
